title: Graphic Design - Level I
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 16S/24Q to fewer than 30S/45Q units

outcomes: At the end of the program, students will demonstrate an understanding of the principles, elements, and language common to graphic design.
At the end of the program, students will demonstrate the ability to critique their own work, as well as the work of other students; and defend their creative choices verbally and in writing.
At the end of the program, students will demonstrate an understanding of a portfolio or "body of work".
At the end of the program, students will demonstrate the ability to use industry standard software and hardware to complete projects.
At the end of the program, students will demonstrate proficiency in the use of images and typography to create successful design solutions.
At the end of the program, students will demonstrate an understanding of historic and contemporary graphic design practices.
Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to interpret and use the principles and elements of design to convey a graphic design message.
Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to critique and defend their own work, as well as the work of others.
Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to create print and digital work.
Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to use industry standard hardware and software to create skills-based projects.
